about_the_game:
You finally booked a stay at the legendary Castle Lustelia… but disaster strikes again! Your precious hentai cards have vanished — scattered throughout the enchanted hotel by someone with a very naughty sense of humor.

Wander through a lavish medieval castle-hotel and uncover your missing cards hidden in the most mischievous spots.

Peek behind tapestries, open ancient chests, lift pillows on royal beds – no corner is safe from secrets!

Unlock seductive new artwork and rebuild your precious deck, one spicy discovery at a time.

Embark on a cheeky, sensual, and delightfully absurd treasure hunt! Can you find them all before checkout?

  • 100 Sensual Cards

  • 7 Interactive Rooms in a Medieval Hotel

  • Play with One Hand

  • Controller Support
